scope: source acceptance of inline references and anchored point markers

acceptance.criterion: Independent references appear between body text at the current or last caret and preserve same-position order.
Real focus, program focus, Escape, removal, search and direct reference-only Send preserve one-time preview behavior.
Identity, source, session scope, same-asset separate objects, exact raw text and valid UTF-16 offsets survive service and CLI operations.
Native multiline text, leading and trailing empty lines, Shift+Enter, trailing-LF paste and empty-body edits preserve exact text and reference offsets.
Both delete keys, both directions of emoji-adjacent movement and cross-atom Shift selection preserve code-point boundaries.
Native composition, delayed rerenders, refresh, queue edits and legacy draft, task and history body-tail references retain their intended positions.
Equivalent nonempty references reconcile held saves and SSE across JSON key order; real conflicts preserve both copies.
Point pin centers match actual clicks across world and normalized coordinates, pan, zoom, native DPR, themes and 320px touch.
Independent popover placement, expansion, same-point comments and reduced motion retain each pin position; legacy and region anchors retain their existing semantics.
Actual PNG rings, capture versions, ownership, retries, queued inheritance and source boundaries retain their existing behavior.
Inline references remain visible in wide and 320px light and dark layouts; content-state geometry assertions check text, references, controls and viewport relationships.
